verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for an API platform and SDK provider like Plaid, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry controls or opt-out mechanism for developers or users of the SDKs, Dashboard, MCP server or Link. The community threads concern end-user financial-data consent, not telemetry opt-out, so they do not establish the capability.
